## Replication packages

Replication data and code for my published work are archived in public repositories:

- **Inputs, Incentives, and Complementarities (QJE 2019)** — KiuFunza Tanzania data: [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/XAOOTR)
- **Outsourcing Education / Beyond Short-term Learning Gains (Liberia)** — [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/5OPIYU) · [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/record/5579799)
- **Designing Teacher Performance Pay (Tanzania)** — [Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7411312)
- **Communal Property Rights and Deforestation** — [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/YMWIAR)
- **Local Incentives and National Tax Evasion (Colombia)** — [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/NML0MG)
- **Direct vs Indirect Management Training (Mexico)** — [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/7SDWNS)
- **Cross-Age Tutoring (Kenya)** — [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/IGZJ2J)
- **Factorial Designs, Model Selection, and Inference** — [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/XG6U9H)
- **COVID-19 Learning Loss and Recovery (India)** — [Harvard Dataverse](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/XGY7CV)

## Health and pharmaceutical data (Colombia)

Datasets I compiled from Colombian government sources for my work on insurer competition and
pharmaceutical prices. These are convenience copies of public information (originally published
by the government in PDF and Excel); I cleaned and consolidated them into plain CSVs.

### Pharmaceutical prices (SISMED)

Reported prices in the SISMED system, one file per year:

[2006](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2006.csv) · [2007](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2007.csv) · [2008](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2008.csv) · [2009](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2009.csv) · [2010](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2010.csv) · [2011](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2011.csv) · [2012](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2012.csv) · [2013](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2013.csv) · [2014](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2014.csv) · [2015](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2015.csv) · [2016](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_sismed_2016.csv)

### Medical-provider directory (IPS / REPS)

Colombia's registry of health-service providers and their branches (from the public REPS
registry, `prestadores.minsalud.gov.co`):

- [Providers (Prestadores)](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_ips_Prestadores.csv) — basic information for each provider
- [Branches (Sedes)](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_ips_Sedes.csv) — every branch of every provider
- [Services (Servicios)](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_ips_Servicios.csv) — services provided at each branch
- [Installed capacity (Capacidad Instalada)](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_ips_CapacidadInstalada.csv)
- [Branch locations (shapefile)](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/data-archive/data_ips_SedesGeo.zip)

*Source government portals: [SISPRO](https://web.sispro.gov.co/), [INVIMA registry](https://www.invima.gov.co/consultas-registros-sanitarios), [REPS provider registry](https://prestadores.minsalud.gov.co/habilitacion/).*
